name: spindev-docs
description: Documentation skills for spinlockdevelopment. Ships the technical-writer subagent + skill: scans a repo, produces a coherent design doc, emits mkdocs-formatted Markdown with the mkdocs-material theme, and is delta-aware (consults a per-repo state file so reruns either incrementally update changed pages or fall back to full regen). Includes a /docs-deploy slash command that scaffolds an opt-in GitHub Pages workflow. Output is plain mkdocs — portable to Cloudflare Pages, Netlify, or any static host that consumes a `site/` directory.
